newsitem.title: USA: InVitro delays decision on stock split.
newsitem.headline: InVitro delays decision on stock split.

text.p: InVitro International on Tuesday said its board of directors will delay a decision on whether to implement a 1-for-10 reverse stock split.
Shareholders approved the stock split at an annual meeting on January 31, where the company also announced the delay.

In a statement, InVitro said it decided to defer its decision on the stock split until new Nasdaq rules are set and until its board can assess initial results from the GiftPax program for Guardian DNA.
Guardian DNA is InVitro's new infant/child safety system that uses genetic material to positively identify a child.
"We should have a preliminary indication as to the level of sales we can expect from the GiftPax (program) by the end of March," Richard Ulmer, chief executive officer, said.
